The color of an eggplant is purple.

The competitor's new loyalty program poses a significant threat to our business. By integrating discounts, rewards, and personalized experiences directly into their mobile app, they are creating a high-friction barrier to switching for their existing customers. This seamless integration likely increases engagement and emotional connection, which directly contributes to higher retention rates. If successful, this strategy will not only solidify their market position but actively erode our customer base as users migrate to the platform offering greater perceived value and convenience. We must urgently evaluate our own retention strategies and digital integration capabilities to mitigate this risk.
